previous.changeLog:
FRONT LINE, PROPERLY
A Front Line battle is several tanks in one game, and the site now records it as
one battle with the totals of every tank you drove - plus a per-tank breakdown
showing what each one earned and what it cost. Battles you leave early are
recovered from the game server, so nothing is lost.

previous.changeLog: Added support for new T11s: WZ-219, Vz. 63P, CAV mod. 71, Ho-Ri Shugo, BV-111; added config + prefab overrides for new branch: Pz.Kpfw. 55, VPz 57, HWK 40, Kpz. 67, Pz. Neu; added configs for other new vehicles: BZ-75 Fireborn, Drills, AMX 29 Belier, VK 45.01 (P), Ironclad, NK-1; added prefab overrides for all double-gun vehicles (removed old configs); added configs for new Onslaught rentals; BP II firing sounds → match other 77 mm QF; WZ-114 reload → manual; fixed Chi-Go, KB-52, D.W. 2 firing sounds; Added 3 new engines: Fiat-Iveco V12 MTCA (CAV mod. 71), Kawasaki Type 98 (Chi-Ri, Chi-To SP, Ho-Ri 2 stock, Ka-Ri, Saryuda), Kawasaki Ha-9-IIb (Mitsu 108, Ju-Nu, Ju-To stock); reworked Kawasaki Type 98 x2 + new Kai variant (Type 4/5 Heavy); old Type 98 x2 → Aichi Ha-70 (Ho-Ri Shugo); fixes for Leyland L60 (Executor) + MT-50T; 107 mm 9S1 → single event (fixes dual playback); optimized 20 pdr & 75 mm rapid auto; shortened all two-stage 152 mm reloads (reduces perk restart issues)

current.changeLog: Fixed a few vehicles with the Kawasaki Type 98 engine sound incorrectly having the old DB605 sounds on non-player vehicles; fixed VPz 57 stock gun missing firing sounds + top engine missing audio; reduced audio volume of start/stop sounds for HL230 P45 (Tiger II)
